embedded.title: Embedded rounds — $push ($each + $sort), arrayFilters, statusHistory
blocks: db.applications.updateOne({ company: "Amazon" }, { $push: { rounds: { $each: [ { name: "Online assessment", scheduledAt: <in 4 days> }, { name: "Recruiter call", scheduledAt: <in 1 day> } ], $sort: { scheduledAt: 1 } } } })
db.applications.updateOne({ company: "Amazon" }, { $set: { "rounds.$[r].result": "Passed", "rounds.$[r].feedback": "Shortlisted for OA" } }, { arrayFilters: [ { "r._id": <recruiter call id> } ] })
db.applications.updateOne({ company: "Amazon" }, { $set: { status: "OA" }, $push: { statusHistory: { $each: [ { status: "OA", changedAt: new Date() } ], $slice: -50 } } })
db.applications.findOne({ company: "Amazon" }, { company: 1, status: 1, rounds: 1, statusHistory: 1 })

window.title: Window functions — $dateDiff + $setWindowFields ($rank, $avg per source)
blocks:
db.applications.aggregate([
  { $match: { status: { $in: ["Applied", "OA"] } } },
  { $addFields: { daysWaiting: { $dateDiff: { startDate: "$lastMove", endDate: "$$NOW", unit: "day" } } } },
  { $setWindowFields: { partitionBy: "$source", sortBy: { daysWaiting: -1 },
      output: { rankInSource: { $rank: {} },
                sourceAvgWait: { $avg: "$daysWaiting", window: { documents: ["unbounded", "unbounded"] } } } } },
  { $sort: { daysWaiting: -1 } }
])
